"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will substantially improve water security and ecological health through conservation, protection, and maintenance of water infrastructure, including water systems for home, commercial, industrial, and agricultural use.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will expand federal programs to help farmers, ranchers, and forest landowners pursue high-productivity, lower-emission, and regenerative agricultural practices in order to help build more resilient, vibrant, local and regional food systems.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will substantially increase investments in voluntary conservation programs, which generate economic and environmental benefits for farmers and their surrounding communities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will support healthy coastal communities and marine ecosystems to sustain and enhance economic well-being, including in the fishing, tourism and clean energy industries.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will support communities and businesses nationwide in their efforts to build zero-waste and circular economies, including efforts to eliminate plastic waste and food waste.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
